Investment Research
(Central Research Team)- What lies at the core of our proposition is our research capabilities to make our offerings best suited to our customers’ needs.  Our Central Research Team (CRT), a team of seasoned professionals who have rich experience of dealing with vast array of financial products with seamless access to best-in-class research tools, ensures that our offerings are not only best in quality but also are reviewed periodically.
SBI Wealth Central Research Team publishes various research reports that enables our customers to remain abreast of the financial markets and economic layout at large.  “SBI Wealth Investment Outlook” is our flagship monthly communique that covers extensively the domestic and global economic updates and our house view on various asset classes.
Apart from the above, CRT releases various daily and weekly research-oriented communications for our client-facing staff. This equip them with all the knowledge they are required to possess to handle our customer queries prudently.
